structured_output.mechanisms: Time is roughly steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost grows with the stage-2 and stage-3 widths, scales mostly with batch size, and drops about 16% when half the steps run at 24px resolution. Accuracy rises with epochs, with diminishing returns. It falls with narrower stages, cutout, random flip, low-res training, and label smoothing away from 0.1. Light translation (2px) helps. Interactions: width×epochs and resolution×steps.
